bio: Set in 365 acres of Perthshire countryside, you’ll find Murrayshall Hotel. Built in 1664, Murrayshall House is now a luxury four-star country house and estate, nestled between the towering trees.  Indulge in a range of sweet treats and savoury delights, with a wide range of speciality loose leaf teas and coffees. Enjoy Slow Roast Scotch Beef & Grain Mustard, Black Pudding Sausage Roll, Carrot Cake with candied pecans and Orange & Polenta Cake.  Add a little sparkle to your day with a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Lynedoch Lounge every day, from 1pm till 4pm. Weather permitting you can take Afternoon Tea outside in the courtyard.  Murrayshall Hotel is located just a short drive from Perth, close to the historic Scone Palace.
